policy.primary_unit: unique folded protein; repeated pH/material conditions do not increase unique-protein count
policy.surface: real solid/material surface or nanoparticle interface
policy.ground_truth: experimental protein-side localization at residue, peptide, domain, or molecular-face level
policy.benchmark_role: literature-derived experimental evaluation; labels are used only after predictions are generated

cases.evidence: limited proteolysis and mass spectrometry; Domain II was identified as the silica-facing region
cases.journal: Journal of Colloid and Interface Science
cases.notes: Broad domain-level ground truth. The original study examined BSA on silica in pH 7.0 HEPES/phosphate buffers and pH 8.0 ammonium bicarbonate; the benchmark uses the pH 7.0 condition.

cases.evidence: covalent protein painting/cross-linking chemistry coupled with mass spectrometry identified three interfacial peptides; residue numbering is the PDB numbering reported in the article
cases.notes: The article explicitly reports PDB-numbered peptides 373-389, 403-410 and 414-428. MES pH 6.2 was used during interface capture/cross-linking.

cases.evidence: position-specific fluorescence/orientation experiment; the residue-10 region reports the silica-facing orientation at pH 6.3
cases.notes: Exact experimental anchor used for coarse spatial localization.

cases.evidence: position-specific fluorescence/orientation experiment; the residue-37 region becomes the diagnostic silica-facing region at higher pH
cases.notes: Same protein as the pH 6.3 condition and therefore counted once in the unique-protein total.

cases.evidence: Lys-to-Ala mutagenesis followed by gold-nanoparticle binding measurements identified K4, K13 and K50 as binding determinants
cases.journal: The Journal of Physical Chemistry C
cases.notes: The mutagenesis experiment establishing K4/K13/K50 was performed at pH 6.4.

cases.evidence: mass-spectrometry accessibility mapping; decreased accessibility of residues 350-380 was assigned to the blocked/contact region on polystyrene nanoparticles
cases.notes: The deposited tetramer is retained. Regions showing increased accessibility were not encoded as contact ground truth.

cases.evidence: mass-spectrometry accessibility mapping; decreased-accessibility regions 140-160 and 480-500 were assigned to the polystyrene-nanoparticle interface
cases.notes: Chains C and E represent the transferrin molecule in 1SUV; receptor chains are excluded.

cases.evidence: NMR chemical-shift perturbation analysis localized the strongest AlumOH-associated perturbations to the Ala250-Lys310 region
cases.notes: The study reports retention of the native-like fold while defining the regional interaction footprint.

cases.evidence: solution NMR localized the preferential MPA-AuNP interaction to the N-terminal tail together with the adjacent BC and DE loops
cases.notes: NMR samples were prepared in 50 mM HEPES at pH 7.0. The operational residue spans encode the experimentally localized N-terminal, BC-loop and DE-loop surface on 1JNJ.

pending_high_quality_cases.reason_pending: position-specific experimental ground truth requires a separately frozen residue mapping before inclusion
position-specific experimental ground truth and the exact structural mapping require a separately frozen audit before inclusion
the residue-level experimental footprint should be extracted independently from simulation-derived contacts before inclusion
